messages:
maria.docs: FYI: found a couple of broken links and an auth snippet mismatch in the 'Hello Minimal' quickstart. Opening a PR in a sec.

sam.eng: thanks — which snippet mismatch?

maria.docs: the Node SDK example still shows old env var NAME instead of REDWOOD_API_KEY and the curl example uses /v1/generate which is the legacy route. Small but confusing for new users.

jia.devex: ugh. I ran into that during the workshop last week. We should also mention token expiry / refresh notes for the starter app.

kevin.pm: can you paste the exact lines? I can grab a quick diff.

maria.docs: sure — in quickstart/hello-minimal/README.md lines ~42-58: code block shows

```bash
export NAME=hello
node start.js
```

should be

```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="<your_api_key>"
node start.js
```

and the curl example: `POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate` -> needs `https://api.redwood.inference/v1/text/generate` per the new routing.

sam.eng: OK I'll update the SDK snippets while you're at it. Want me to add a short note about token permission scope?

jia.devex: yes, please. Also add a tiny blurb about local dev: how to set a local .env and run `npx dotenv -- node start.js` — some folks use Docker and that helps.

maria.docs: opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427 — fixes snippets, updates curl route, and adds a short token troubleshooting section.

deploy-bot: Deployment check queued for branch docs/hello-minimal-snippet-fix (ETA ~5m).

kevin.pm: great. Can we also ensure the Python snippet uses the new `client.text.generate` path? I remember a few SDK naming changes in SDK v3.

sam.eng: done — I pushed a commit that aligns Node/Python/TS examples and adds a one-line note about SDK v3->v4 migration differences.

jia.devex: quick ask: could we add an example of the minimal prompt and the recommended temperature (0.2) for deterministic starter behavior? New users get weird long responses otherwise.

maria.docs: good call. I'll add a short example prompt and a recommended settings table.

kevin.pm: who should QA this? @jia.devex can you run through the examples locally and confirm they work with a fresh account?

jia.devex: can do. I'll test Node and Python, plus Docker run. ETA ~today EOD.

maria.docs: thanks. Also linked to the migration guide: docs/migrations/sdk-v3-to-v4.md so users upgrading will see the differences.

sam.eng: one more nit — the README had a broken anchor to /docs/intro#auth, changed that to /docs/auth/#overview. I fixed it in the same PR.

maria.docs: nice. PR description updated with a checklist: updated snippets, fixed links, added token troubleshooting, added prompt settings, verified deployment.

deploy-bot: Deployment success for docs/hello-minimal-snippet-fix at sha abc123 (staging).

jia.devex: QA pass: Node and Python examples run end-to-end with a new API key, Docker build works, curl route responds. Left one small grammar nit in the README; pushed a tiny change.

kevin.pm: excellent. Maria, want me to merge the PR or do you want to wait for one more reviewer?

maria.docs: looks good to merge. @sam.eng can you do a quick skim and then merge?

sam.eng: merging now. :shipit:

maria.docs: thanks team — I'll update the quickstart index page to reference the new examples and add a short changelog entry.

kevin.pm: can we add a redirect for the old curl URL in case external links point to it?

maria.docs: yes, I'll add a redirect rule in the site config.

deploy-bot: Production deploy queued for docs site (include redirects).

jia.devex: left a tiny suggestion for the troubleshooting blurb: add a bullet about corporate proxies blocking outgoing traffic; some customers hit that during onboarding.

maria.docs: added it. Closing the thread after prod deploy completes. Great teamwork! :tada:
